regions.merged_text: many thanks for your practical rememberance of our Jubilee here July 24. God willing, I surely hope to see you have that privileged distinction in just a few years more - yourself and Fr. Boniface . . Glory be to God! We certainly had a happy - in a way - an unique celebration. Our Monastery Chapel of course was too small for anything of that kind. Thanks be to God - and to our two neighbor - pastors we had an ideal set-up . Solemn Mass in St. Mary - Irish Parish with a German Pastor - Miller - and the dinner - breakfast (about 300) in SS. Peter and Paul's School Auditorium - Father Schmitz the Pastor. The two have a High School together . · One could only wonder at the doctrine there manifest - communion of saints.
